context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about a celebrity sighting
purpose: Teach: 美人/こども/さっぱり/またまた/そこそこ/あらためて/かたち/気配

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、さっき店の前にすごい美人女優が立ってたの。
lines.en: Hey listen, a stunning actress was standing in front of the shop earlier.
lines.style: Excited whisper leaning across the counter conspiratorially.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、またまた冗談でしょ？信じられない…！
lines.en: Huh, you're joking again, right? Unbelievable!
lines.style: Playfully skeptical with rising romantic curiosity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当だってば。サングラスで顔はさっぱり見えなかったけど、オーラが違ったの。
lines.en: I'm telling you it's true. Couldn't see her face at all behind the sunglasses, but her aura was different.
lines.style: Insistent yet hushed, gesturing at her own face.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: へえ…誰かのこどもを連れてた、みたいな話もあるよね最近。
lines.en: Wow... there's also been talk lately about her being with someone's kid, right?
lines.style: Dreamy intrigued tone, twirling a coffee stirrer slowly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それそれ。横にそこそこ背の高い男の人もいて、家族みたいなかたちだった。
lines.en: Exactly that. There was a fairly tall guy beside her too, looking like a family unit.
lines.style: Eager gossip mode with vivid hand sketching shapes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ロマンチック…あらためて考えると、芸能人も普通の人なんだね。
lines.en: How romantic... thinking about it again, celebrities really are just normal people.
lines.style: Soft sigh, chin resting on hand, eyes faraway.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でしょ？でも帰った後も、しばらく人の気配がドアの近くに残ってた気がして。
lines.en: Right? But even after they left, I kind of felt someone's presence lingering by the door for a while.
lines.style: Lowered voice, mock shiver, glancing toward entrance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それ絶対ファンが隠れてたんだよ。明日も来るかな、見たいなあ。
lines.en: That was definitely a fan hiding. Will they come tomorrow? I want to see them.
lines.style: Giggling with hopeful wistful anticipation in voice.
